text:
Jordan Grimmer-Tufik because it isn't. Sitting in your daughter's living room in Katzrin is not the same as taking selfies on Via Dolorosa and paying 1000 a day for an average hotel room. A tourist wants to see and experience things and wants to go back to their lives. A visiting parent.. another story. We can argue about this until we turn blue, but fact is that there are groups of illegal immigrants living in Israel. Look up the articles about the Georgian Community here. 
I don't mind going through an extra procedure, I am happy there's a procedure that allows entry. I mind paying taxes that go to fund the prison time and the flight home for the illegal immigrants. Honestly, if anyone got kicked out, their own country should be held responsible and not let them fly to Israel again.
